data.narrative:
Substrate is a Series A frontier-tech company in Chips & Semiconductors, founded by James Proud and Oliver Proud, having raised $100M+. The valuation universe consists of 11 same-sector peers: 3 public companies (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private firms including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. Within the semiconductor peer set, only one same-stage and one adjacent-stage company were identified, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median triangulation. The stage-progression method was therefore the primary applicable approach. Using the $100M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, this method yields an implied valuation of $200M.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $170M to $230M, with a median point of $200M. This range reflects a single-method derivation, introducing material uncertainty around the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the stage-progression multiplier to Substrate's specific risk and growth profile, the absence of direct peer comparables at identical stage and scale, and the inherent volatility in frontier-semiconductor valuations. Investors should view this range as indicative pending access to additional financial metrics and comparable transaction data.
